en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a formal city park with terraces, balustraded stairways and ornamental gardens. In the foreground are stone railings, planters and gas-style lamps; two well-dressed men stand talking on the path while women in long dresses walk further inside the park. Trees and hedges line the walkways, and a large villa-like building stands in the background. Caption text in German is printed at the bottom margin.
